A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 6 submissions per epoch. The attacker spends 117 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all.
